regime_context: The detector shows AI Infrastructure as the leader (eligible, durability 0.68, not crowded) above a narrow eligible set of 19 themes; breadth is narrowing and rotation is non-directional. The only validated edge is the absolute-trend gate (drawdown control), so theses below are conditional leans, not return forecasts. The backtest verdict explicitly states momentum rank-IC is weak and the trust record shows direction accuracy near coin-flip (0.483) despite a decent hit rate, so conviction is kept low.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Cybersecurity (rank #2, trend, breadth 1.0, but crowded z 1.8) can hold its leadership-adjacent position: if CIBR holds its 20-day average and the crowding_z normalizes below ~1.2 while staying eligible, the crowding caution would be retired; if it breaks below and loses breadth, the watch would be retired as a leadership handoff that did not confirm.

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: US Energy Complex is eligible, trend-tagged, not crowded (z 0.83), with breadth 0.73. It ranks #4 by momentum but the supporting legs here are the trend-gate eligibility (the only validated edge), the trend hurst tag, and its non-crowded texture. It is not the leader, so this is a structural preference for an eligible trend theme rather than a momentum chase.
theses.dissent: Energy is cyclical and the narrow breadth of the overall eligible set (19/49) suggests a fragile tape; if macro risk appetite rolls over, a crowded-out but momentum-lacking theme can give back quickly.

falsifier.text: XLE breaks below its 50-day moving average and US Energy Complex falls out of the eligible set before the check-by date

theses.subject: Technology (Equal-Weight)
theses.thesis: Equal-weight technology is eligible, trend-tagged, and not crowded (z 0.72). Ranked #7, it is a lower-conviction structural idea than the leaders, but its trend health and breadth (0.69) support a hold-over-trim bias versus the narrow AI Infrastructure leader, which has a 'mixed' hurst tag and fading valuation state.
evidence: eligible true, durability_bar 0.82 (strongest among top-10 tech themes)
theses.dissent: Equal-weight tech is heavily correlated with the crowded AI Infrastructure complex; if the AI theme unwinds, this theme suffers the same drawdown even without the crowding label.

falsifier.text: XLK underperforms SPY by more than 5% while remaining trend-tagged before the check-by date

theses.subject: Robotics & Automation
theses.thesis: Robotics & Automation is eligible but carries a 'mean-revert' hurst tag — the only top-15 theme with this tag — suggesting momentum is already decaying. This is a case where the detector's trend-discipline leg argues against holding, even though the rank is mid-table.
theses.dissent: Mean-revert tags can be noisy; if robotics order flow inflects higher or a capex catalyst arrives, the theme could re-trend and this avoid call would be too cautious.

falsifier.text: BOTZ re-tags to 'trend' and breaks above its prior 20-day high before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
